set.title: Campaign mode crashes on level entry: ReferenceError: state is not defined
set.body:
## Evidence

Browser smoke test against https://chata-games.github.io/forest-rescue/ (scripts/e2e_forest_rescue_pages.py in chata-games.github.io):

```
ReferenceError: state is not defined
    at startLevel (src/heartwood-game.js:459:11)
    at Object.start (src/heartwood-game.js:502:7)
    at startLevel (src/campaign.js:112:16)
```

- **Repro**: any browser → Campaign → tap any level marker (or `?level=…`). 100% of entries.
- **Observed**: `#gameScreen` shows, but the HUD stays at placeholders (mana `100`, `Wave 1 / 8`) and nothing animates — `state = createGameState()` throws before `loop.start()` runs.
- **Root cause**: `state` is never declared in the `initHeartwoodGame` closure. ES modules are strict mode, so the bare assignment `state = createGameState()` throws instead of creating a global. Present on `origin/main` (deployed); `src/heartwood-game.js` last touched 2026-07-14 (8b4da3c).
- **Not affected**: `?mode=legacy` (uses `this.state` / instance state) and the newer Phaser `app/` build — which is what the existing Playwright e2e covers, which is why this shipped undetected.
- **Suggested fix**: declare `let state = null;` next to `let fireState` in the closure (`src/heartwood-game.js:75`), re-run `npm run test:e2e`-style browser check against the root game.
- **Regression test**: `python3 scripts/e2e_forest_rescue_pages.py` (repo: chata-games.github.io) — currently red on this exact bug; goes green when fixed.

set.title: Direct-level URL (?level=) leaves start screen overlay up, blocking all input
set.body:
## Evidence

Found while verifying RP-bfjtvp with scripts/e2e_forest_rescue_pages.py (flow 4, `?level=` direct entry):

- `index.html` ships `#startScreen` without the `hidden` class and with `z-index: 20` (full-viewport overlay).
- `campaign.js start()` only unhides/hides screens when there is **no** `?level` param; with the param it leaves the start screen up while the level auto-starts underneath.
- Result: on `?level=<id>` the player sees the start screen; the battle runs invisibly and every trusted tap hits the overlay (verified via `document.elementFromPoint` → the start screen `H1`), so nothing is playable.
- `hideAllScreens()` in `src/main.js` exists but is dead code — never called.

**Fix**: call `hideAllScreens()` in `main()` before starting the campaign/legacy shell; `campaign.start()` re-shows the start screen in the no-param path, and `?level=` gets a clean battlefield.

text: Fixed in forest-rescue 9f47de9 (declared closure battle state). Deployed to Pages and verified: scripts/e2e_forest_rescue_pages.py passes all four flows against https://chata-games.github.io/forest-rescue/ (clean load, map entry, planting, full battle resolution on 00-hand-test-s-curve).

set.title: npm run serve is broken: CommonJS serve.js in a type:module package
set.body:
`npm run serve` (the README's documented dev entry) crashes on main: `serve.js` uses CommonJS `require`, but `package.json` sets `"type": "module"`, so Node refuses:

```
ReferenceError: require is not defined in ES module scope ... use import instead
```

Convert `serve.js` to ESM imports (or rename to `.cjs` and point the script at it).

reason: declared closure state; live Pages smoke passes end to end

set.title: level6-fire simulation test fails on main (0% upgrade win rate)
set.body:
`node --test tests/simulation/level6-fire.test.mjs` fails on clean `origin/main` (no local changes):

```
✖ level 6 fire spread punishes cheap builds but upgrade-first can clear
  AssertionError: fire tools too weak: 0% upgrade win rate
```

Pre-existing — reproduces with `git stash` on 7ab9522 (origin/main). Unrelated to the RP-bfjtvp fix (one declaration line); needs a balance pass or updated simulation expectations.

reason: hideAllScreens() on ?level= entry; verified live via flow 4 of the Pages smoke

text: Fixed in forest-rescue commit fbbb13d (pushed to main, Pages deploy run 33409901233 completed). serve.js converted from CommonJS require/__dirname to ESM imports + import.meta.dirname (package.json sets type:module). Verified: node serve.js boots and serves 200s; local e2e smoke (FR_E2E_SITE=http://localhost:8341/, served BY the fixed serve.js) exit 0; production smoke vs https://chata-games.github.io/forest-rescue/ exit 0 (all 4 flows pass). vitest 301/301 pass; note: pre-existing failure in tests/simulation/level6-fire.test.mjs (node --test) repros on clean main, unrelated to this ticket.

reason: serve.js converted to ESM; npm run serve works; local + production smoke both exit 0 (commit fbbb13d)

text: Root cause was the sim bot, not the level: the upgrade-first bot's cleansing-rain heuristic demanded >=2 burning rings before casting, so it hoarded mana while fire chipped defenders and blocked replanting, losing 100% of level 6 runs. The real game lets players cast rain any time (no such gate in heartwood-game.js), so the bot under-modeled competent play. Fix forest-rescue 165d49b: cast on the first burning ring -> level6-fire sim now 20/20 upgrade-first wins (60/60 on extended seeds, ~3 hearts margin) with cheapest-dps at 0/20, matching the test's design intent. Verified locally: node --test tests/simulation/*.test.mjs 21/21 pass, npx vitest run 301/301 pass. Pages deploy of 165d49b succeeded and production smoke (scripts/e2e_forest_rescue_pages.py vs https://chata-games.github.io/forest-rescue/) PASSED end to end. Note: spell data declares cleansing-rain douseImmunity 8 but douseArea is called with the default 5 in both game and sim (dead field) — not touched to keep this change minimal.

reason: Sim bot fix (forest-rescue 165d49b): rain on first burn -> upgrade-first 100% / cheapest-dps 0%; all suites green; prod smoke PASS

set.title: Pages smoke flow4 false-passes: hidden end overlay ships static 'Game Over' text
set.body:
scripts/e2e_forest_rescue_pages.py flow4_battle_resolves() polls text_of('#endTitle') for 'Victory'/'Game Over' as the battle-resolution signal, but index.html ships the hidden overlay with static initial text:

Game Over

and

The jungle was cleared into farmland.

(index.html lines 62-63). The poll therefore matches on its FIRST read, seconds after planting, while the battle is still running — 'full battle resolution' never actually waits for anything. The follow-up 'replay visible' check is equally void: it tests !#replayButton.classList.contains('hidden'), but the button never carries its own hidden class (hiding is via the #endOverlay ancestor), so it always reports True. Evidence (live, 2026-08-31, https://chata-games.github.io/forest-rescue/): script printed "battle resolved -> 'Game Over' (The jungle was cleared into farmland.); replay visible: True" and exited PASS, while its own final screenshot (/tmp/fr-pages-e2e-final-outcome.png, captured immediately after) shows the battle mid-progress — Wave 1 / 3, 4 hearts, no end overlay on screen. The same trap briefly bit this round's new scripts/e2e_forest_rescue_all_levels.py (v2 poll matched the static text instantly on every level, reporting all 7 battles 'resolved' at Wave 1); fixed there by requiring !#endOverlay.classList.contains('hidden') alongside the title text. flow4 needs the same treatment: poll (overlay visible AND title in Victory/Game Over), and derive replay visibility from #endOverlay's visibility. Impact: the smoke's strongest assertion is a no-op; a regression that freezes the engine before the end screen (the class of bug RP-bfjtvp fixed) would still PASS flow4. Repro: python3 scripts/e2e_forest_rescue_pages.py (defaults to live site); observe the resolution claim within seconds of planting; open /tmp/fr-pages-e2e-final-outcome.png — no overlay visible.

text: Fixed in parent repo commit abdff77 (scripts/e2e_forest_rescue_pages.py). flow4 now polls (endVisible AND title in Victory/Game Over) — same pattern as e2e_forest_rescue_all_levels.py — and derives replay visibility from #endOverlay's visibility. Local smoke vs http://127.0.0.1:8341/: PASS exit 0; production smoke vs https://chata-games.github.io/forest-rescue/: PASS exit 0. Both resolved with the LIVE message 'The Heartwood was breached.' (not the static 'The jungle was cleared into farmland.' the old poll false-matched) and reported overlay visible: True; replay visible: True; final screenshot shows the real end overlay.

reason: flow4 poll now requires visible #endOverlay with Victory/Game Over title; replay visibility derived from overlay — local and production smoke both PASS exit 0 (parent commit abdff77)

set.title: Defenders never fire: missing cooldown decrement in DefenderEntity
set.body:
## Evidence (agent playtest 2026-08-31: 19 runs, 19 defeats, zero kills on any level)

`src/entities/defender.js` initializes `this.cooldown = 0.45` (line 15), gates firing on `this.cooldown > 0` (line 24), resets after firing (line 39) — but NEVER decrements it. The decrement exists only in `legacy-lane.js:97` (`this.cooldown -= dt`). Result: every defender fires at most once per... actually never (cooldown starts > 0). All 3 playtest agents measured zero DPS across levels 1, 4, 7.

## Fix
Add the decrement in the entity's update (mirroring legacy-lane.js), with a regression test: step a defender's update(dt) against a stationary dummy and assert the dummy dies within a bounded number of steps.

## Rider (agreed in debate): visible shot
Ship minimal fire feedback — a projectile or beam plus a death poof — so the fix is verifiable by eye, not only by assertion. Keep it in the existing rendering layer's style.

## Post-fix re-measure (consensus item 6 — required before any balance change)
Every HP/DPS number from the playtest was measured against inert defenders. After this lands: script a role-correct opener per level (towers on chokepoint/long-range/gate rings within ~6s), run wave 1, and retune borer HP / tower DPS / starting mana ONLY if wave 1 still leaks >= 2 hearts against that opener. File retuning as a separate ticket if needed.

## Acceptance
- [ ] decrement present; dummy-kill regression test green in vitest/node suite
- [ ] visible shot + death poof observable in a screenshot
- [ ] local + live e2e (scripts/e2e_forest_rescue_pages.py, scripts/e2e_forest_rescue_all_levels.py) pass
- [ ] re-measure note recorded on this ticket (wave-1 leak count with role-correct opener)

set.title: Fit the game to any window: card-bar overflow, canvas clamp, HUD scoping
set.body:
## Evidence (agent playtest: all 3 players, all levels)
Card bar: cards at `min-width: min(280px, 92vw)` in a non-wrapping flex row = 8x280 + 7x8 = 2296px min width — the measured page overflow width. On a 940px window only 3 of 8 cards reachable; after Replay the canvas snaps 924->2296px pushing spawn-side rings, pause and mute off-screen. Stale HUD ("Wave 1 / 8", placeholder mana) bleeds through menu screens (hardcoded markup in index.html).

## Fix
1. Card bar: wrap to two rows or cap the game-screen grid track with minmax(0, 1fr).
2. Clamp canvas/#canvasWrap to the viewport on level entry AND window resize (this shifts the screen<->world mapping — re-verify placement taps and pause/mute reachability).
3. Scope the HUD to the game screen only (no stale values behind menus).

## Acceptance
- [ ] at 940x850 all 8 cards reachable; canvas fits viewport on entry and after Replay
- [ ] e2e smoke (which plants defenders and pauses) still passes local + live

set.title: Gate wave 1 behind a Start-Wave button; show next-wave timer between waves
set.body:
## Evidence (agent playtest: all 3 players lost hearts/runs while reading the screen)
Wave 1 engages ~1.5-2s after level load. Consensus mechanism: explicit Start-Wave button (unlimited prep for novices, instant retry loops), plus a visible "next wave in Ns" countdown BETWEEN waves. Rejected in debate: fixed countdown, first-placement auto-start, field-clear gating (deletes genre time pressure).

## IMPORTANT — e2e coupling
scripts/e2e_forest_rescue_pages.py and scripts/e2e_forest_rescue_all_levels.py (parent repo) assert the wave counter advances on its own after level entry. This ticket MUST update both scripts to press the Start-Wave control after entering a level, and both must pass local + live.

## Acceptance
- [ ] no wave spawns until Start-Wave pressed (including after Replay)
- [ ] between-wave countdown visible
- [ ] both e2e scripts updated and green against local server and live Pages

set.title: One-line role text on every defender card (plus range ghost at placement)
set.body:
## Evidence (agent playtest: P1 learned Thornvine is on-path-only from source code, not the game; blind purchases all session)
Every card gets a one-line ROLE description (e.g. "Blocks enemies on the path", "Shoots from beside the path"). Order agreed in debate: role text first, stat numbers later/never for now. Also: a range ghost (placement preview showing the defender's range) when a card is selected. Card-bar space is tight until the viewport-fit ticket lands — keep role lines short; land that one first.

## Acceptance
- [ ] every card shows a short role line
- [ ] selecting a card shows a range ghost at the hover/press point
- [ ] e2e smoke still passes (local + live)

set.title: Fix mana flower taps: generous hitbox, pickup burst, consistent sprite
set.body:
## Evidence (agent playtest: P2 went 0-for-4 tapping flowers in Mushroom Hollow; P3 collected both Boulder Pass flowers)
Tap target is `f.r * 1.4` with r=22 (~31 world px) on an 8.5s despawn — too small for thumbs/agents. Per-level divergence suggests a data bug on top of the shared hitbox: audit flower spawn data across levels, not just the hitbox.

## Fix
1. Enlarge hitbox (>= 1.8x radius) 2. Pickup burst/flash + floating +25 (P2 never saw mana change) 3. One consistent, gently pulsing flower sprite (current plus/crescent/half-disc glyphs read as UI chrome).

## Acceptance
- [ ] scripted taps at flower centers land reliably (add an assertion to a test or verify manually via e2e screenshot sequence)
- [ ] flower data audit note recorded per level

set.title: Make placed defenders readable: distinct silhouette, placement flash
set.body:
## Evidence (agent playtest: P3 could not find Thornvine in any screenshot after placing it; P2 could not distinguish 2-3px sentinels from ring glow in dark Mushroom Hollow)
1. Distinct silhouette + subtle persistent outline per placed defender type so players can verify what they built. 2. One-shot placement flash on plant so the purchase is confirmed visually. Constraint from debate: the outline must NOT read as a selection highlight (no selection UI exists yet).

## Acceptance
- [ ] each defender type distinguishable in a screenshot at 940px width
- [ ] placement flash observable; e2e smoke passes (local + live)

set.title: Make rejected actions speak: ring highlight while placing, rejection shake + reason, +mana on kill
set.body:
## Evidence (agent playtest: all four rejection cases — wrong ring type, no mana, paused, no selection — are silent; P1 burned 3 of 7 attempts unable to tell rule from bug)
1. While a defender card is selected: green-tint VALID rings only (green-only per debate; red tint rejected for mid-wave noise; selection-scoped, never always-on). 2. Rejected plant: shake + floating reason ("Needs an open-path ring", "Not enough mana"). 3. Floating +8 (actual amount) on kills so income is visible.

## Acceptance
- [ ] each rejection case shows a visible reason (verify via e2e screenshots or a scripted check)
- [ ] kills show floating mana gain; e2e passes local + live

set.title: Game Over summary: wave reached, enemies leaked, mana banked
set.body:
## Evidence (agent playtest: P2's defeat modal froze an idle 593 mana behind nothing; P3 died banking 256+)
Defeat (and Victory) modal gains a small read-only summary: wave reached, enemies leaked (hearts lost), mana banked. Uncontested in debate; makes every future loss readable and helps balance work.

## Acceptance
- [ ] modal shows the three numbers on both outcomes
- [ ] e2e smoke passes (its outcome assertion now also sees the summary; local + live)

text:
Shipped: forest-rescue e29cea1 — DefenderEntity.update now decrements cooldown (Math.max(0, cooldown - dt)) before the gate; the decrement previously existed only in legacy-lane.js and the sim bot, so live defenders sat frozen at the 0.45 windup forever.

Evidence:
- Regression test tests/simulation/defender-fire.test.mjs (2 tests): stationary-dummy kill within bounded steps + multi-shot cadence (>=4 shots/6s). Verified RED on pre-fix code (git stash), GREEN post-fix. Suites: node --test 65/65 pass, npx vitest run 301/301 pass.
- Visible shot + death poof (debate rider): screenshot /tmp/fr-shot-08.png on the hand-test level shows the cyan seed-bolt projectile in flight beside a logger plus the green (#a5ff70) death burst; rendering already existed (drawProjectileEntity + onEnemyHit burst) and became observable once firing worked. Pages e2e flow-4 hand-test battle now resolves 'Victory' (was guaranteed-Game-Over with inert defenders).
- Local e2e (http://localhost:8341/, python3 -m http.server): e2e_forest_rescue_pages.py PASS (exit 0), e2e_forest_rescue_all_levels.py PASS (exit 0; level 5 wave-1 game-over is the script's documented idle-run case).
- Deploy: gh run 33445293985 success; live bundle serves the decrement (curl grep confirms).
- PRODUCTION e2e: e2e_forest_rescue_pages.py PASS (exit 0, hand-test = Victory), e2e_forest_rescue_all_levels.py PASS (exit 0, all 7 levels).

Post-fix wave-1 re-measure (consensus item 6). Instrument: runSimulation against a level copy truncated to wave 1 (loop ends when wave 1 clears, hearts = post-wave-1); opener = role-correct cheapest-dps (sprig-sentinel long-range DPS on furthest chokepoint ring; first plants at t=0/2/4s, inside the ~6s window; no wave-1 fliers on any level, so no anti-air role needed). Hearts after wave 1 / leaks: 01-meadows-edge 5/0, 02-old-stump-crossroads 5/0, 03-whispering-river 5/0, 04-mushroom-hollow 5/0, 05-sawmill-clearing 5/0, 06-ashfall-scar 2/3, 07-boulder-pass 3/2. Levels 6 (3 leaks) and 7 (2 leaks, tunnel-borer wave) meet the >=2-leak retune threshold from the ticket — retuning borer HP / tower DPS / starting mana should be filed as a SEPARATE ticket (not done here per loop guardrails).

reason: Cooldown decrement added + regression test; visible shot/poof verified; local+production e2e green; wave-1 re-measure recorded (levels 6-7 flagged for separate retune)

text:
Fixed in forest-rescue 46b1eef (deployed to Pages, run 33448135223 success).

Root causes fixed:
1. Card-bar overflow: .game-screen's implicit grid column sized to the toolbar's min-content (8x280px+gaps=2296px). Capped the track with minmax(0,1fr) (landscape side-rail track too) and added flex-wrap:wrap to .toolbar so cards flow onto extra rows.
2. Canvas snap 924->2296 after Replay: consequence of (1) — view.resize() measured the overflowed wrap. Additionally clamped canvas size to window.innerWidth/innerHeight in setupCanvas() on every resize (entry, Replay, window resize). Screen<->world mapping re-verified: placement taps still land (e2e plants via replicated viewTransform), pause+mute reachable.
3. Stale HUD bleed: .hidden{display:none} lost the source-order fight with .game-screen{display:grid} (equal specificity, later rule), so #gameScreen was NEVER display:none — HUD + static Magic Tree card bled through start/campaign screens. Restated as .game-screen.hidden{display:none}.

Evidence:
- Local (http://127.0.0.1:8341/, serve.js): e2e_forest_rescue_pages.py EXIT=0 (incl. new flow5 fit checks: scrollWidth 940 at 940x850, canvas+wrap inside viewport before AND after Replay, pause/resume + mute toggle), e2e_forest_rescue_all_levels.py EXIT=0 (fit green on all 7 levels; Boulder Pass: 8 cards reachable).
- Production (https://chata-games.github.io/forest-rescue/): pages EXIT=0, all-levels EXIT=0 — Boulder Pass live: '8 cards reachable, scrollWidth 940'.
- Screenshots: start screen and campaign map clean (no HUD bleed, /tmp/fr-start-fixed.png, /tmp/fr-map-fixed.png); after-Replay fit /tmp/fr-pages-e2e-after-replay.png.
- Tests: vitest 301 passed, node --test 65 passed. Scripts updated in parent (viewport pinned to 940x850 via Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride; fit assertions added to both) so the acceptance is now regression-guarded.

reason: Grid track capped + card bar wrapped + canvas clamped + HUD hidden state fixed; 8/8 cards reachable at 940x850, canvas fits entry and post-Replay; local+production e2e green.
